name: Draggable horizontal review carousel with reply cards
notes: Real Google reviews for a live client, kept verbatim as a content pattern reference (swap in the target business's own reviews before reuse). The reply line under each card — owner responding by name — is the standout trust device here; worth reusing even without the carousel. Horizontal scroll uses a CSS mask to fade the edges instead of hard-clipping cards; JS drag-to-scroll (grab/grabbing cursor) not included but the CSS supports it as pure scroll-snap too.
